title: Malabar Police
desc: After running away together, two people witness the murder of a minister. Later, the police officer assigned to investigate the case embarks on a mission to find them.

title: Soora Samhaaram
desc: Pandian, a police officer, sets out to take revenge on a drug lord for the murder of his best friend, Arun. However, Pandian gets abducted by the criminal and is forced into drug addiction.

title: Kaalamellam Kaathal Vaazhga
desc: A mutual passion for music attracts Kausalya and Jeeva to each other, via phone calls. Over time, their connection grows stronger, and their frequent conversations spark a love story between them.

title: Marutha
desc: Unable to return her brother's monetary favour, Meenakshi's husband ends his life. When her brother's wife expects her to repay the money, Meenakshi sees it as a chance to reclaim her lost honour.
